tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Use this when the user names a French company (or gives a SIREN or SIRET) and you need to identify it: returns up to 20 matches with name, SIREN, status, legal form code, NAF code and head-office city. Name matching is a prefix match on the official name. Do not use for people, officers or sharehold

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Use this when you know a company's SIREN and the user wants its identity, or wants to pre-fill a business customer's onboarding form: name, active or ceased, legal form code, NAF code, creation date, head office, establishments, share capital and current officers (name and role only), with sources a

tools.name: get_establishment
tools.description: Use this when the user gives a SIRET (14 digits) and wants that establishment's address, activity code, status and whether it is the head office. Do not use to find all establishments of a company; get_company lists them.

tools.name: list_bodacc_notices
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what was officially published about a company (registration, changes, sale of business, insolvency proceedings, removal) and you know its SIREN: returns the latest BODACC notices, newest first, with links to the official text. Do not use to search notices by person, court

tools.name: get_bodacc_notice
tools.description: Use this when you have a BODACC notice identifier (for example from list_bodacc_notices) and need its detailed content. Personal details such as birth dates and home addresses are never included. Do not use to look for notices without an identifier.

tools.name: list_company_documents
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know which deeds or annual-accounts filings a company has registered (title and dates), with a link to download them from the INPI. Do not use to read financial figures; the documents themselves are not returned.

tools.name: search_addresses

tools.name: get_legal_notice_price
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much a legal notice (annonce légale) costs for a formality in a French department: returns the exact regulated price excluding and including VAT, set by ministerial order and identical in every authorised newspaper of that department. Notices priced by the character n
